# (PART) Report 2 · Fine-mapping {-}

# Cross-ancestry fine-mapping of placental xQTL loci {.unnumbered}

**Fine-mapping report (Report 2 of 2) — SuSHiE credible sets, PIPs, and
enrichment analyses**

*Bhattacharya Lab (analysis: S. Bresnahan; report generated with Biomni/Phylo)*

This report takes the Report 1 association signals to causal-variant
resolution with cross-ancestry SuSHiE fine-mapping, then asks what the
high-confidence variants and genes do: functional-annotation enrichment,
gene-set enrichment, and deep dives on the most recurrent loci.

Chapters in this report:

- **Overview** — locus and credible-set summary
- **PIP diagnostics** — posterior inclusion probability distributions
- **Credible sets** — set sizes and composition versus conditional signals
- **Cross-ancestry concordance** — effect agreement between EAS and EUR
- **Top loci** — highest-confidence genes and modality recurrence
- **Functional-annotation enrichment** — consequences of high-PIP variants
- **Gene-set enrichment** — high-confidence genes against curated gene sets
- **Run diagnostics**, **Methods summary**, **Session info**
